name: forest
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. One cinematic photorealistic frame for a montage imagining social and ecological crises in the year 2250. This is fictional speculative art, not a factual forecast. Extremely wide panoramic 3:1 composition, one continuous photographic scene. Restrained serious political tragedy, quiet tension, tactile real materials, believable optical perspective, professional film photography with restrained grain. Cohesive palette of graphite shadows #252A2D, muted sage #536459, weathered copper #93634E and dusty warm greys. No spectacular science fiction, no fantasy, no flying vehicles, no neon. Crucial composition: centre the key action within the middle 40% of image width AND between 32% and 65% of image height; image will be cropped into a very shallow full-width website banner, and horizontally centre-cropped on phones. The lateral thirds should extend the atmosphere naturally. Avoid strong foreground/background perspective conflicts; use medium telephoto optics and simple readable layers. Absolutely no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions, no real identifiable political party.
Scene: A dead forest in a distant warmer future: tall skeletal trunks disappear into a dense grey dawn mist, dusty scorched earth, a few remnants of tree roots at mid height and fallen branches. A quiet close view through repeated trunks rather than a vast landscape. Fine suspended ash, lifeless air, muted graphite and sage. Few tiny pale ash flakes. No people. The fog and tree spacing are the subject. Soft indirect light, sombre rather than theatrical.
